text: Suitable for lunch and dinner. Has various vendors and big parking lots.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า

text: Good Place

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: Clean restrooms, plenty of food and beverage options, a pharmacy, beauty salon, Inthanon coffee shop, rice and curry, noodle shop, massage parlor, dental clinic, post office, mala restaurant, and much more. Convenient parking with ample spaces. The area is clean and well-decorated.
author_name: มะนาว ว๋าน

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: There's also an Ayutthaya boat noodle shop, but the taste isn't quite there yet. There's a wide variety of restaurants. The Monobuchan milk tea is good. There's plenty of parking, easy to find a spot, but the parking in front fills up quickly.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: Came specifically for Vietnamese food at Winner House. It's OK. Plenty of parking, not chaotic, clean bathrooms. People around there probably like it because you don't have to go far to find delicious food for them to eat 🍲🥘🍳🥙🍖 …

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text:
There are plenty of shops to choose from for seating.
The back area is lovely, with delicious food at reasonable prices. Parking is convenient, and the music is great.
There's also a boxing gym and a surf area for those who like to work up a sweat 😁
When you get hungry, you can enjoy savory and sweet dishes at the front area. From what I've tried, everything is delicious.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: Plenty of parking, lots of shops, tons of delicious food. I love it!
author_name: คุยสบายสไตล์สนุก #sabyesanooktalk

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: A small outdoor shopping center located on the main road, with a variety of shops and restaurants. Parking is available in front of the shop, true to the slogan "Park and enjoy the food immediately."

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text:
📌 There are many restaurants and plenty of parking.
🍽 Ayutthaya Boat Noodles, Sai 2, located in the project. The flavor is bold and sweet. Choose from regular and special options. 🐷 Crispy pork rinds are delicious.
♦️ Fast and good service.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: The project has everything: noodle shops, mala hotpot, Japanese food, a beauty clinic, a dental clinic, plenty of free parking, restaurants at the back, and a gym.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: There's a beauty salon and nail salon in the complex where the staff used inappropriate and offensive language with customers, and pressured them into buying products. It was very uncomfortable and annoying. I'll definitely only use their service once.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text:
Newly opened! A new food hub in the Ekachai-Bang Bon area.
Featuring a wide variety of restaurants,
coffee shops, pet grooming salons, and many other shops.
The project is located right on the main road, offering easy access and a spacious parking area at the back. Clean restrooms.
author_name: แอ๊ป รักไท

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: It's a small plaza but packed with a variety of food shops, and they even have Kerry Express delivery service. The restrooms are clean, and there's plenty of parking.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: There's a wide variety of shops to choose from: Japanese food, yakiniku (grilled meat), rice and curry, noodles, a post office, Kerry Express, and plenty of parking. Everything you need in one place.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text:
There's so much delicious food here...
both spicy and mild.
Plenty of parking and easy access.
author_name: นกขมิ้น เหลืองอ่อน

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: Delicious food, clean place, spacious parking. Highly recommended!
author_name: สาวิตรี ป่าหญ้า

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: The Rich Plaza Bang Bon is a newly opened plaza with a variety of restaurants, convenient parking, and a Kerry Express branch.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: The highlights include very convenient parking. Regarding the taste of the food, honestly, I think every restaurant should improve the flavor a bit; it would be much better then.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: There are lots of delicious food stalls here.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: Come try this newly opened curry rice restaurant. Everything is delicious!
author_name: รัตติกาล คชสูงเนิน

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: There's plenty of food and ample parking. However, be sure to check the time of day, as traffic can be heavy if you're driving.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text:
There are plenty of restaurants, both for lunch and dinner.
The prices are reasonable, with savory dishes, desserts, and drinks available!
There are shared restrooms available, which are very clean.
author_name: อรนลิน ภูเตศวร

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: It was delicious! The meat was thick-cut, not thin at all. The abalone soup was very flavorful and easy to drink.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: Located near the main road, with a wide variety of food options available.
author_name: ธิติกาญจน์ อ่อนแก้ว

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: A variety of restaurants, plenty of parking in front and behind the building.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: Lots of food options and parking available.
author_name: สรายุทธ สุดสนอง

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: It is a food court and service center with ample parking space for all users.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: I was in the area for some errands, so I stopped by this restaurant. The food was delicious.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: I came here for a head and hair spa at Anna Hair Spa & Sleep Salon for the first time, and it was amazing! So relaxing, my hair is so soft, and the service was great. After the treatment, I had boat noodles at the shop next door; they were delicious and affordable.
author_name: พิมพ์รักษ์ สุขพิทักษ์

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text:
A hub for restaurants on Ekkachai Road, right at the U-turn.
A variety of delicious food options. I've tried the Yoshi Japanese Restaurant for 488 baht per person, which is a great value and delicious. I recommend the steamed salmon head with soy sauce, which is incredibly appetizing.
Convenient parking available in both the front and back, with over 100 cars.
There's also a steakhouse,
Buppet with Fat for 199 baht,
a chicken rice restaurant with firm meat, and
Pao Pak grilled fish restaurant with a spicy flavor.
Buppet offers a variety of restaurant-style food, including seafood, steamed fish, and luxurious stir-fries. The buffet is priced at 4XX baht.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: I went to eat at Tid Mun (a restaurant). The parking was easy, there were a lot of people but it didn't feel crowded, and the food prices weren't expensive. I saw a skating rink in the back, and there was a constant breeze. Overall, it was good.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: There are a variety of restaurants, but not many. The Japanese food is reasonably priced, the buffet has many options, and the Thai rice noodles are delicious and affordable.
author_name: ปลาหมึก เป็นต่อ

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text:
There aren't many shops, but there's a wide variety.
They have sushi, shabu-shabu, Hainanese chicken rice, boat noodles, papaya salad, BBQ pork, grilled fish, and many more. Good parking and clean restrooms.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: ...There are a variety of shops and convenient parking...

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: There's plenty of parking. There are many restaurants with various styles and reasonable prices. The Japanese buffet is 488 baht, which is great value. The food is fresh, clean, delicious, and the service is excellent. However, it can get quite crowded.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: Convenient parking. Just turn off Bang Bon Road; it's right by the road. There's an Inthanin coffee shop nearby, and the boat noodle stall is delicious (highly recommended!). The grilled squid at the stall across the street is very fresh. Haven't tried the other stalls yet.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text:
The plaza in Bang Bon is relatively new.
It has many delicious restaurants.
There's Shabu Bootung branch 37.
There's also an Internin coffee shop.
There's live outdoor music.
There are various food and beverage stalls.
They are lined up along the plaza.
There is parking available in front and behind the plaza.
The plaza isn't very large.
It's a good place to eat.
It's easily visible from the main road.
It's another great place to check in and have fun.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: There are a lot of restaurants, a lot of parking, and a designated activity area at the back for youth to use for skating. It's really great!

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: I pass by this area every day. It's convenient that there's a Kerry Express and Thailand Post office nearby. There's a wide variety of food and lots of desserts to choose from. I like it. Parking is very convenient.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: The Rich is located on Ekkachai Road. There's parking in front, but it's not very large, but it's a good place to eat. …

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: Shabu Butung also has ice cream! The black syrup, coconut, and strawberry ice cream are all delicious. Service is incredibly fast; even with so many customers, the food arrived in less than 10 minutes after ordering. The staff are friendly, and the food is clean and fresh. #HighlyRecommended 👍👍👍👍👍 …

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: Easy to get to and the food is delicious.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า

There are plenty of restaurants, both for lunch and dinner.
The prices are reasonable, with savory dishes, desserts, and drinks available!
There are shared restrooms available, which are very clean.

restaurant_name: เดอะริช พลาซ่า
text: There are many restaurants with a wide variety of food to choose from. There's plenty of parking both in front and behind the building.
